text: dsh-omni-browser 是一款 DSH 浏览器工具插件，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 操作本机 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium。它提供页面导航与交互、DOM 和无障碍信息读取，并可把 HAR、控制台、浏览器存储、截图及 PDF 等页面证据保存为带清单的本地文件夹。适合需要自动操作网页、检查页面状态或留存可复现页面资料的 DSH 用户；需要 Node.js 22+、DSH tools 服务和本地 Chromium 系浏览器，不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-omni-browser controls local Chrome, Edge, or Chromium from DSH. It reads and interacts with pages and saves screenshots, PDFs, HAR, console, and storage details in a local evidence folder. Requires Node.js 22+, DSH tools, and a local Chromium-family browser; no API key.
我想让 DSH 自动点击网页并读取页面内容。
怎样把网页的网络请求、截图和控制台记录打包留存？
I need to capture a web page and its network activity into a local evidence bundle.
dsh-omni-browser 的功能「页面证据打包」：将当前浏览器页面的内容和状态整理到本地文件夹，并生成 manifest。捕获项包括页面快照、截图、PDF、HAR、控制台和存储信息；可通过 omni_capture 触发。
dsh-omni-browser 会连接调用者指定的网页，并可将该页面的请求记录及响应内容纳入本地捕获文件；源码未配置固定的第三方云端服务或 API 密钥。
dsh-omni-browser 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-omni-browser README · dsh-omni-browser：> **Control a real browser — and take the whole page with you.**
> 16 `omni_*` tools that drive Chrome/Edge over CDP *and* capture everything a page is as one self-contained evidence folder.

dsh-omni-browser README · dsh-omni-browser：Most browser plugins in the DSH marketplace give you a remote control. `dsh-omni-browser` gives you a remote control **plus a forensic camera**: DOM, accessibility tree, HAR with response bodies, console log, cookies/storage, full-page screenshots, PDF and a screencast — all written into one timestamped folder with a manifest.

No npm dependencies, no bundled Chromium, no cloud service. It starts the Chrome you already have and talks raw CDP.

| Console + uncaught exceptions | sometimes | ✅ |

| Full-page screenshot + element screenshot + PDF | partly | ✅ |
| Screencast frames of what actually happened | ❌ | ✅ |
| One-call **evidence bundle** + manifest | ❌ | ✅ `omni_capture` |
| Bounded multi-page **harvest** | ❌ | ✅ `omni_harvest` |

dsh-omni-browser README · Why another browser plugin?：Use it for: agent research on real sites, bug reports that must be reproducible, compliance/archival snapshots, scraping where you need the network truth (not just the rendered text), and "why did the page show that?" debugging.

dsh-omni-browser README · Quick start：```
manifest.json          schema + per-artifact status + timings
page.json              title, url, meta, outline, links, forms, counts
page.png               viewport screenshot
page-full.png          full-page screenshot (beyond the fold)

Every part degrades gracefully: if PDF or a response body is unavailable, the rest of the bundle is still written and the manifest records the error.

dsh-omni-browser README · The 16 tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `omni_status` | Is Chrome running, which tabs, version, profile. `action: launch \| close \| restart` |
| `omni_open` | Open a URL (reuse tab or `newTab`), wait for `load`/`domcontentloaded`/`networkidle` |
| `omni_tabs` | `list` / `new` / `close` / `activate` |
| `omni_page` | Read the page: `snapshot`, `text`, `html`, `ax`, `links`, `forms`, `meta`, `outline`, `frames`, `resources` |
| `omni_act` | `click`, `dblclick`, `hover`, `focus`, `type`, `press`, `scroll`, `select`, `check`, `uncheck`, `upload`, `drag`, `wait`, `back`, `forward`, `reload` — real input events |
| `omni_eval` | Evaluate JS in the page, get JSON back |
| `omni_screenshot` | `viewport` / `fullpage` / `element` / `clip` → real file |
| `omni_pdf` | Print current page to PDF |
| `omni_network` | `list`, `body` (one response body), `har`, `stats`, `save`, `clear` |
| `omni_console` | `list` / `clear` / `save` console + exceptions |
| `omni_storage` | `all`, `cookies`, `local`, `session`, `indexeddb`, `cache`, `sw`, `save` |
| `omni_capture` | **one-call evidence bundle** |
| `omni_harvest` | bounded crawl, one bundle per page |

dsh-omni-browser README · The 16 tools：Element targets accept `{ "selector": "#id" }`, `{ "text": "Sign in" }`, `{ "ref": "ax:1234" }` (from `omni_page mode=ax`) or `{ "x": 100, "y": 200 }`.

dsh-omni-browser README · Configuration：All optional — set via the plugin `config` in `cordis.patch.yml`, or environment variables:

dsh-omni-browser README · Configuration：| Env | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `OMNI_CHROME_PATH` | Browser executable | auto-detect Chrome/Edge/Chromium |
| `OMNI_PORT` | CDP port (`0` = pick a free port) | `0` |
| `OMNI_HEADLESS` | `1` / `0` | `1` |
| `OMNI_USER_DATA_DIR` | Browser profile directory | `~/.dsh/omni-browser/profile-<DSH profile>` |
| `OMNI_OUTPUT_DIR` | Where captures go | `<cwd>/omni-capture/<timestamp>/` |
| `OMNI_HOME` | Plugin data home | `~/.dsh/omni-browser` |

dsh-omni-browser README · Configuration：The plugin uses its **own browser profile**, so it never touches your personal Chrome session. Cookies you log into inside the managed browser persist between runs (same profile directory).

---

dsh-omni-browser README · Privacy & safety：- Captures may contain **secrets** (session cookies, tokens in headers, page content). Treat `omni-capture/` as sensitive data. Use `includeValues: false` with `omni_storage` to keep keys but redact values.
- The browser profile is isolated by default, but anything you type into it is real — use a dedicated account for risky automation.
- This tool is for sites you are allowed to access. It is not a scraping-as-a-service bypass and does not solve CAPTCHAs.

---

dsh-omni-browser README · How it works：```
index.js            host entry: config, shared session, 16 tool registrations
lib/cdp.js          Chrome lifecycle + raw CDP transport (WebSocket, no deps)
lib/snapshot.js     page model: text/html/AX/links/forms/meta/outline/resources
lib/actions.js      trusted input actions

Tests run against a local fixture site (`test/server.mjs`) with a real headless Chrome — no internet required:

dsh-omni-browser README · How it works：```bash
node test/smoke.mjs        # CDP transport health check
node test/tools.test.mjs   # all 16 tools end-to-end
```
